events.text: {"verdict":"proceed","decision":"The fresh walk has stalled. /tmp/t471/walk.log stops after card 20 (start-tantra [connect] done), and /tmp/walk/t471 has only 20 screenshots and no report.json. Then read the tail of centre.log and sim.log to find what the card after start-tantra waits on (probably a sim route or job missing on this checkout) and fix it at the source. (2) Reset the private stack (8940/8942/8944) and rerun the walker with nohup on the tantra-revops fixture until report.json exists. (3) Patch any simulator gaps that remain: Twilio, Zoom polls, GHL workflows, calendar campaign, outreach-sheet share/simulate, ga4-gate. Add the Zoom path and the content cards to OPTION_CARDS. (4) If a finding cannot be fixed, write down why it only happens in the simulator.
